name: krea-ai
description: Generate, edit, enhance, upscale, and animate with Krea through your own OAuth-connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Create, enhance, and upscale with Krea
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Krea through a local OAuth companion for live model discovery, image and video generation, LoRAs, enhancement, upscaling, and reliable long-running workflows without API keys or a hosted relay.
defaultPrompt: Use Krea to create a polished image, wait for the asynchronous job to complete, and return the original asset.
List Krea's live models and recommend the best one for this prompt.
Enhance this image to the highest useful resolution while preserving its visual character.
